unknown_stratum.note: Structurally degenerate control: 'unknown' is not a taxonomy class, so no agreement with the rule is possible. The recovery control is instead the pass-1/pass-2 agreement within each stratum and the fact that the models reproduce the unknown-stratum gold at only ~55%.

near_duplicate_students_train.note: Keyword-matched scorable rows not caught by exact clean_notes match that are near-duplicates of the students' training notes.
